title: P104: a seven-stage retimed price and the open all-size storage invariant
body:
## Exact numerical candidate and open tape obligation
A seventh ordinary stage on the unpowered retimed construction funds κ = 0.003890115286594460 at the price level. Its ordinary rate is 0.00389011528659446005. The construction retains the 24-cell binary and 31-cell numerical couplings and all 36/48 charged calls. All 54 strict and four functional signed inequalities pass. A separate derivation checks the stage, stripe and clock bounds. It remains open to prove a uniform all-size assignment of every live owner, suspended frame, spool and historical head to the proposed tape inventory. Consequently this candidate adds no complete same-premise multiplier claim above #8044.

## Source and scope
The frozen source is Ali Romman’s #8042 at 3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35. The now-current e2cc22679a4ab690fa4ef2eda9576cf4a1455b82 lowers the six-stage resource cost at the same reported exponent with a different receiver and two-scale numerical source. This package uses the earlier 7/(2H) binary debit, original numerical supplier and seven explicit stage logs. Main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57; #8030 at 6285dd829114705862e8d91facaedc1f31d3cfcb. Shared #7257 CI prerequisite 0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026. This is a partial application proof.

## Measured checks
CPython 3.12: python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-seven-stage-retimed. All six final registered cases passed in 662.31 s after increasing the measured recipe setup allowance within the existing 1,200 s total. A cold price case passed in 12.14 s; damage to either dependency archive is rejected. A finite signed control returns −345550037539, with 138 shuttles and 157,248 H calls. This reduced geometry uses the local H kernel. Production-size seven-stage execution has not been observed.

## Credit and follow-up
Ali Romman supplied the retimed physical sources, DreamingOfClouds the #7852 toolkit and Clear1nsight coordinated the research with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The next proof needs a uniform bound for actual owner lifetimes at each OPEN, ISSUE and CLOSE, including nested returns and simultaneous private storage. Extra arithmetic margin alone cannot supply that premise.
